title: Learning to build covering structures with continuous adjustments
abstract: arXiv:2609.08669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic construction offers the potential to use materials more efficiently and create complex geometries, but current methods rely on rigid, high-precision plans that cannot accommodate the tolerances, inaccuracies, and unexpected changes inherent in physical fabrication. In this work, we introduce a reinforcement learning approach that forgoes predefined plans entirely, instead generating construction sequences adaptively as the structure is built. Our method operates on graph-structured state representations and a mixed (parameterized) action space, requiring both discrete block selection and continuous placement parameters. Because the stability simulation of a structure is computationally heavy, we develop an efficient exploration strategy by incorporating unilateral edges into graph neural networks, extending soft actor-critic (SAC) to this hybrid setting. translated_title: 学习通过连续调整构建覆盖结构
translated_abstract: 机器人建造具有更高效利用材料和创造复杂几何形状的潜力，但当前方法依赖于刚性的、高精度的计划，无法适应物理制造过程中固有的公差、误差和意外变化。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种强化学习方法，完全摒弃预定义的计划，而是在结构建造过程中自适应地生成建造序列。我们的方法基于图结构的状态表示和混合（参数化）动作空间运行，需要同时进行离散的积木选择和连续的放置参数调整。由于结构的稳定性模拟计算开销很大，我们通过在图神经网络中引入单向边来开发一种高效的探索策略，将软演员-评论家算法（SAC）扩展到这种混合设定中。我们针对先前的方法混合PPO（HPPO）对算法HSAC进行了评估。
tldr: 提出了一种名为HSAC的强化学习方法，无需预定义计划，通过引入单向边的图神经网络和混合离散-连续动作空间，在建造过程中自适应地生成建造序列，以应对物理制造中的误差与不确定性。
en_tdlr: Proposes HSAC, a reinforcement learning approach that forgoes predefined plans and adaptively generates construction sequences during building, using graph neural networks with unilateral edges and a hybrid discrete-continuous action space to handle fabrication tolerances and uncertainties.
